param: δt Discrete time step length (quarter of a day)
N Total population size for the season (England)
β Transmission rate parameter in λ(t)=β*I(t)/N (frequency-dependent)
σ Progression rate through exposed stages (E1→E2 and E2→I1); implies mean latent period d_L=2/σ
γ Progression/recovery rate through infectious stages (I1→I2 and I2→R); implies mean infectious period d_I=2/γ
π Initial susceptibility: proportion of population initially susceptible
λ₀ Initial infection rate at t=0 under EGR parametrisation (used for inference)
ψ Exponential growth rate (EGR) at epidemic start (used for inference)
p_ICU Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection
μ_ICU|E Mean delay from infection to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma approximation)
σ²_ICU|E Variance of delay from infection to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma approximation)
η Negative binomial dispersion parameter for weekly ICU/HDU counts
λ(t) Force of infection at time t
R₀ Basic reproduction number (defined via EGR parametrisation in paper)
Rₙ Effective reproduction number in partially susceptible population
TAR Total attack rate over the season (probability a susceptible individual is infected)
I₀ Initial total infectious individuals (derived quantity reported in results)
